Overview

Ennis is a city in Clare with a population of 26,000. A charming market town in County Clare, known for its traditional Irish music scene, medieval streets, and proximity to the Cliffs of Moher and the Burren. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
